verses.en: Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of God endureth continually.
verses.pt: Por que tu, homem poderoso, te orgulhas no mal? A bondade de Deus continua o dia todo.
verses.en_web: Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker. Maschil. Of David. When Doeg the Edomite came to Saul saying, David has come to the house of Ahimelech.> Why do you take pride in wrongdoing, lifting yourself up against the upright man all the day?

verses.en: Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp rasor, working deceitfully.
verses.pt: Tua língua planeja maldades; é como navalha afiada, que gera falsidades.
verses.en_web: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
verses.en_bbe: Purposing destruction, using deceit; your tongue is like a sharp blade.

verses.en: Thou lovest evil more than good; and lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.
verses.pt: Tu amas mais o mal que o bem, e a mentira mais do que falar justiça. (Selá)
verses.en_web: You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: You have more love for evil than for good, for deceit than for works of righteousness. (Selah.)

verses.en: Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.
verses.pt: Tu amas todas as palavras de destruição, ó língua enganadora.
verses.en_web: You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.
verses.en_bbe: Destruction is in all your words, O false tongue.

verses.en: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of thy dwelling place, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.
verses.pt: Porém Deus te derrubará para sempre; ele te tomará, e te arrancará para fora da tenda; e te eliminará de toda a terra dos viventes. (Selá)
verses.en_web: God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: But God will put an end to you for ever; driving you out from your tent, uprooting you from the land of the living. (Selah.)

verses.en: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:
verses.pt: E os justos o verão, e temerão; e rirão dele, dizendo:
verses.en_web: The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,
verses.en_bbe: The upright will see it with fear, and will say, laughing at you:

verses.en: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.
verses.pt: Eis aqui o homem que não pôs sua força em Deus, mas preferiu confiar a abundância de suas riquezas, e fortaleceu em sua maldade.
verses.en_web: “Behold, this is the man who didn’t make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.”
verses.en_bbe: See, this is the man who did not make God his strength, but had faith in his goods and his property, and made himself strong in his wealth.

verses.en: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.
verses.pt: Mas eu serei como a oliveira verde na casa de Deus; confio na bondade de Deus para todo o sempre.
verses.en_web: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.
verses.en_bbe: But I am like a branching olive-tree in the house of God; I have put my faith in his mercy for ever and ever.

verses.en: I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done it: and I will wait on thy name; for it is good before thy saints.
verses.pt: Eu te louvarei para sempre, por causa do que fizeste; e terei esperança em teu nome, porque tu és bom perante teus santos. Instrução de Davi, para o regente, sobre “Maalate”:
verses.en_web: I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your saints.
verses.en_bbe: I will give you praise without end for what you have done; I will give honour to your name before your saints, for it is good.
